title: Easy to cook with, beautiful red color. Loose, wobbly handle makes it risky to use when hot
text:
Easy to cook with, beautiful red color. Loose, wobbly handle makes it risky to use when hot. Compared to my high end cookware, this pan is just as nice to cook with. I did a smoked sausage in it and nothing stuck or stained. Making a quick gravy wasn't a problem either - everything mixed and nothing burned on. I like the deep, candy apple red color and the size of the pan is really functional.

My problem is with the handle. Mine arrived loose and wobbly, enough so that I don't feel comfortable using it to lift the pan off the stove with food in it. I have had to use pot holders both times that I cooked with it. See my photo - the silver base of the handle twists where it's connected to the pan wall. That's unfortunate because I sort of like this thing.

features: SPECIFICATIONS: Includes a 4 Quart hydro-ceramic deep cooker sauté pan and a glass steam vented lid with an elevated lift handle

EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS: This multipurpose pan is built to perform and last. Extra durable construction offers even heat distribution. Riveted stay cool silicone handle provides a safe, confident and comfortable grip. Superior non-stick ceramic coating prevents food from sticking; allowing you to use less oil for healthier meals for you and your family.
EASY TO CLEAN, INSIDE AND OUT: The hydro-ceramic interior releases foods effortlessly and allows for a fast and easy clean-up.

COOK YOUR WAY: This high-performance fry pan cooks a wide range of foods to include breakfast favorites such as omelets, pancakes, bacon, sausage, hash browns and eggs, as well as quesadillas, vegetables, chicken, fish, pork, steak and more.
USE AND CARE: The advanced hydro-ceramic technology is water-based and manufactured without PFOA.
description: Experience the sheer pleasure of convenient cooking with non-stick ceramic deep cooker with lid. Beautiful, durable and easy to clean—what more could you ask for? Featuring heavy gauge aluminum construction with a high gloss exterior and smooth and durable Hydro ceramic non-stick interior, This bliss ceramic deep cooker has a tempered glass lid with steam vent and a stainless steel induction base that's suitable for all cooking surfaces. Exceptionally durable, this non-stick ceramic cookware retains its glossy appearance over time. The soft-touch silicone handle stays cool to the touch and has a comfortable grip. With bliss, healthy cooking is easier because theres no need for a lot of added butter or oil—the water-based non-stick ceramic coating is designed for easy food release and ideal for braising, frying, sauteing and searing.
